Vivek / Redwood team,

Quick readout from prelim traces:
- Kernel-level traces show a decode kernel path taking ~2.2x longer under q8_profile for longer sequences (median sequence length on Avalon is ~280 tokens during checkout).
- There are increased lock-contention signals in the continuous-batcher when sequence variance spikes (seen in the attached kernel-trace).
- Error pattern is consistent with queueing timeouts rather than model outputs — clients hit upstream timeouts and return 502/504.

Recommendations (fast to medium):
1) Emergency rollback to v5.0 + q4_profile (expected RTO: 18-30 minutes if we follow the rollback playbook).
2) Canary rollback: shift 30% of traffic back to v5.0 immediately and evaluate for 15 minutes; full shift if p95 improves and 5xx drops.
3) If rollback risky, deploy a compatibility fallback at routing layer to send checkout-critical requests to the older variant only (complexity: routing changes + config push, ETA ~45 min).

I attached kernel-trace-q8.log and highlighted the hot loops. I can own rollback with infra support; will need a runbook sign-off and a short maintenance window to avoid races.

-Rishi
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime
